reviews.x: I had bought a different cordless flosser but returned it as the water pressure was too much for my gums. I am glad I returned that and bought this as this is so much better. Its easy to handle and the different pressure intensity makes it suit wide variety of gums. Its also easy to fill the container and drain out water. Only negative thing I noted was that while traveling, if the buttons got pressed, the flosser would start. So pack it well and it should be fine!

The first few times I used the product everything worked fine.  The 3rd time I was not able to place the tip in the unit where it would hold.  As soon as the pressure is turned on the tip fly's out. It will not grab..  Very disappointing I have almost never returned anything and don't even know how but this unit broke on the third try.

reviews.t: As Powerful as an Electric Water Flosser
reviews.x: I like to use a water flosser as part of my daily dental routine. I had a problem as to what to do when I traveled and was gone from home for long stretches. The h2o water flosser has solved that problem! The varied levels of pressure are perfect for whatever level of pressure you might desire. I had purchased a different brand of cordless water pick but its weak stream of water meant it wasn't worth the room that it took up in my suitcase. The h2o cordless flosser is as powerful as an electric

reviews.t: This product is of exceptional quality!
reviews.x: I have used the H2ofloss hf-9 (Whisper) for the last 18 months and have been very happy with its performance.  My wife and I use it daily and are very pleased with everything about it, especially the company's customer service.  When I broke a small piece off the hf-9, customer service replaced the part, free of charge and did so promptly. Because of my exceptional experience with the hf-9 and the company, I chose to purchase the new H2ofloss hf-6, Professional Cordless Dental Oral Irrigator. I

This works well, but has a major design flaw: The on/off button and the button that varies the water pressure are right next to each other. When you are using the flosser in the shower (with your eyes shut so you don't get hit in the eye) you often miss the on/off button and increase the water pressure by mistake. And let me tell you, the highest water pressure is hazardous. In one case it cut my lip!  They should have the two buttons separated, or at least distinguished so that you don't mistak

DESIGN:  The chrome-plated plastic buttons and cap add a nice touch to the look of the flosser, but it feels a little cheap and will probably wear off quickly. The overall fit and finish is good. It has a nice weight to it—not too heavy or too light. It fits rather comfortably in the hand, even small hands, but the placement of the on/off button creates the sensation that you may unintentionally push it. It doesn’t seem to be a problem, though. The charging port comes with a small rubber insert

reviews.t: Mine leaked.  Returned and replaced and the replacement leaked too !
reviews.x: It is a shame both of mine leaked as I really liked it ! The  psi on high was very very strong !  Unfortunately though it was leaking and was making a mess. I could not figure out where the leak was but hopefully they will have figured this defect out and make sure it does not happen with the newer ones. Meantime I bought another brand and although the psi is not as good as this one,,, it does not leak !
even on the lowest setting the amount of pressure this releases hurts your gums and separates them  from your teeth causing pain not happy :(

This is a poorly-made irrigator knockoff from China. Not only would ours not charge fully, but after about a week it simply exploded and almost set fire to our house. If I could give it zero stars, I would.

The flosser works as advertised and, with the ability to change power settings, is a highly functional tool. Unfortunately, when the irrigation is completed and all remaining (visible) water is emptied from the holding chamber, the tool continues to leak onto the counter and requires a tissue or some other absorbent material to be placed beneath it when stored. The battery seems to need constant charging when not in use.
Leaks all over the place. But customer service was excellent.
Leaked.  Returned immediately.  Water all over counter!

reviews.t: Portable for travel and strong water force
reviews.x: This water flosser is easy to pack and fit in my small suitcase. It also comes with a small bag so I can put equipment together inside and grab and go when I prepare for business travel. The battery provides good capacity and so that I don't need to charge for days when I was traveling, and just charge it after back to office. The water tank is not large, and I need to fill water twice, so therefore I feel it is easy to use and control because of its small size. Although it is battery powered an

It stopped working after 1 month. Turns on but the water doesn’t come out. I’ve changed my rating from a one star to a five star. After my initial issue they contacted me sent me a new one and it works perfect and the customer service was much appreciated!
This product was terrible.  The gel they put on the strips is so sticky, I had a very hard time getting it off.  I would definitely not buy this product again.

I really didn’t want to review this right now but here it go! I love the packaging, the size and all the little size able water picks that come with it. Very nice. You can travel with it, it’s not small but it’s not big either. It’s bigger than my shaving equipment for sure. That’s the positive now the negative is, it feels very cheap, and plastic. Also you better start on the lowest water pressure as possible at first, because if you don’t it can do some harm to your bathroom mirror, walls and

reviews.t: Don’t buy H2O Floss Brand products!
reviews.x: This is the third h20 flosser I have purchased from this company and all have failed. The first and second ones were countertop units and both broke within a few months. After multiple attempts, the seller refused to reply to warranty requests and I was stupid enough to buy again. Then I chose to try this portable one, which is now leaking after a few weeks! Don’t BUY h2ofloss brand, obviously, they have problems and Conpany/seller does not stand behind their products!

I purchased this unit to replace a counter unit from the same brand which performed very well during 3+ years.  Sadly started leaking on the third day of use.  Performance is good with the all the options offered for intensity. Size is perfect for home use or travel.  Little concern because I notice that the outlet for the electric charger can be spill with water if you are not careful closing that space.  I sent this unit back.  Maybe I got a defect unit.

Love using this flosser, easy to work, great for travel, holds a charge for two weeks.....But, the water reservoir leaks, and now there is water up inside where the top of the reservoir meets the white handle, and looks rusty....afraid to use due to leakage.  I gave it 5 stars in battery life, easy to use, and for travel....but it fails In leakage and sanitary safety.  It’s been less than 7 months, since purchase that’s why I’m giving it one star.

reviews.t: Cleaned well for less than a year until battery won't charge
reviews.x: The H2Ofloss is a major disappointment.  It worked well as far as cleaning. But, it has lasted less than a year and will no longer charge. When it worked, the location of the button for controlling the strength of the water stream was a problem. Either the device can be turned off by accident or the strength of the stream can be accidentally increased to an uncomfortable and undesirable high level. Also, the water chamber leaks.

reviews.t: was OK for a couple of months...then
reviews.x: Bought this item mid OCt. 2019 and thought it fine originally.  The biggest drawback for me is how close the power button and the degree of power buttons are to each other yet it appears that all power flossers look the same regardless of manufacturer. Now here it is mid Jan, 2020 and the power button is stuck on the highest setting. I use the flosser every day and did not expect it to go south on me after 3 months.

I bought the H20floss in October, and really fell in love with it.  It's very thorough and effective.  After 3 months, my unit started to malfunction where the water wouldn't come through the plastic tip.  I wrote the company, and received a response the next day!  They apologized and sent me a NEW unit which came within a week.  I'm very impressed with the company and the product.  Great customer service!!!

Good Points-good power -light weight- Bad Points-Hard to plug in for charge & hard to remove the cord after charge-After flossing, no matter how much  you wipe the unit off, the tank leaks! Leaks a lot!! This is my second one and they both did the same leaking! Warranty is useless because it gives you no way to contact them to send it back to China!

reviews.t: Died in way less than 6 mths.
reviews.x: Purchased this in October 2019. Loved it, so I bought another.  So I use one & charge one However this is July & the first one no longer works. So each one was only used half the time. So actually much less than 6 mths of use b4 it died.  Unacceptable!!!!!!!!

I loved this water flosser until the reservoir stared leaking from the seam. It was only two months old and never traveled with it. I will buy an official waterpik now, this knock off was not well made.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the adjustable pressure settings, saying the varied intensities suit different gum sensitivities and needs.
A common complaint is leaking, with several reviewers reporting water leaking onto the counter or unit failure.
Customer service is frequently praised, with reviewers noting replacements and helpful support.
Some reviewers find the pressure too strong or painful even on lower settings.
A few reviewers report durability and design problems, including tips not staying in place, buttons placed too close together, and units failing or breaking.
